flowRoot.flowPara: • Choose your Tether - and who you tether to - based on the situation. Potent Soul and Stalwart Soul are useless without the right (S) cards in one or both of your hands.
• Entwined Soul is best used when you or an ally really need to activate a certain Heroic.
• Soul Echo's bonus effecttriggers from any kind of bonus damage - whether its from Potent Soul,weaving (S) cards or something else.
• Essence Shift can seem limiting, but the fact that it has effectively unlimited range makes it extremely powerful.
• Your hand of (S) cards is very important. Use Well of Souls early and often to keep it full.
• The total bonus damage added to a strike can never exceed the base value of that strike. Weaving a (S) card adds bonus damage.
• "Tethered ally" refers to whichver ally you last chose with Fates Intertwined. An ally remains tethered until you choose a new ally to Tether to.
• You cannot change Tethers without also changing allies, but you can choose the same Tether you last chose when you choose a new ally.
• Potent Soul and Stalwart Soul count the total number of cards in both yours and your Tetehred ally's hands.
• You cannot "steal" an ally's cards with Entwined Soul. The ally must agree to the trade.
• If multiple shields are stacked, the shields are used up in whatever order the unit being struck chooses. (This may be relevant to Strength in Unity / Unbreakable Union).
